name: My Candy Love: New Gen
storyline:
Explore the colorful streets of Amoris, discover in the coolest office in the whole city, and most of all, get to know your attractive coworkers, become friends with them, or even more... Or perhaps you'll let yourself fall for your rival?

Dive into a captivating and original story, filled with profound and endearing characters.
Bonus +: Discover five unique Crushes and watch your relationship evolve over the episodes!
summary:
My Candy Love: New Gen is a free otome game/romance game where the scenario completely adapts to your choices for a unique love story! Join a community of more than 72 million players around the world and immerse yourself in an adventure where your decisions determine the course of the story, and allow you to experience a unique and personalized romance.

My Candy Love: New Gen is a new game from the My Candy Love franchise.
